## Post
👋

I hired my professor's whole computer-vision team from BU and flew them out to this mansion in Bel-air to live and work together.

We had a system in stadiums, where we set up 40 cameras, reconstructed 3D in real time, and let you traverse the space in real time.

We had already solved this in my first startup.

That was cool.

They paid me pretty well, and afterward I was able to retire for a bit.

That worked out pretty well.
